name: Monster Summoning
body:
Requires spell familiarity. You learn the spells summon monster and summon nature’s ally for each spell level you can cast, but you cannot have an active monster while you have one or more creatures summoned in this way. When you cast either spell, you can choose one of your summoned creatures to grant you spells as if it were your active monster.
